title: helianthemum almeriense subsp. scopulorum
intro: Helianthemum almeriense subsp. scopulorum, commonly known as Almerian Rockrose, is a plant species in the family Cistaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its ability to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its potential to reduce fever and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of Helianthemum almeriense subsp. scopulorum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
